place.name: Alto de la Alianza Monumental Complex
place.description: The Alto de la Alianza Monumental Complex (Spanish: Complejo Monumental Alto de la Alianza) is a historical monument and landmark complex in the south of Peru, near the city of Tacna. The monument is located at the plateau of the Intiorko (also known as the Alto de la Alianza), a hill that overlooks the city of Tacna.
